subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 runtime core foundation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this durable runtime, persisted schema, Gateway protocol, CLI, and environment surface as a permanent core contract?
rationale: Repairing the concrete database-lifetime defect does not settle whether this broad cross-owner beta foundation belongs in core or what minimum durable contract maintainers want to support.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded foundation
options.body: Approve the direction but narrow this slice to the minimum shared-state and read-only protocol foundation, with the lifecycle repair and exact-head upgrade proof required before merge.

options.title: Keep it experimental
options.body: Retain the prototype outside permanent core contracts until storage ownership, protocol scope, and later stack dependencies are validated together.

options.title: Decline the core direction
options.body: Close the stack if maintainers do not plan to support a native durable runtime and its operator contracts.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded foundation
recommendation.body: Approve the direction but narrow this slice to the minimum shared-state and read-only protocol foundation, with the lifecycle repair and exact-head upgrade proof required before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Available current-main history shows the strongest recent integration ownership across the central state, Gateway, and agent paths.
